faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor (Irrigation & Drainage Engineering), 2 Assistant Professor (Farm Machinery & Power Engineering).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached in the notification PDF) and send it to Dean (Agril.Engg), College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology, VNMKV, Parbhani, by hard copy submission, to reach by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 45,000 per month for Assistant Professor (Irrigation & Drainage Engineering), Rs. 45,000 per month for Assistant Professor (Farm Machinery & Power Engineering).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Tech (Agril. Engg) with NET/SET or Ph.D (Agril. Engg). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidate must work anywhere in the jurisdiction of VNMKV, Parbhani. Must submit undertaking on Rs. 500 stamp paper. Must join within seven days of order issue.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registered students of any University/Institute.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Shortlisting based on 1:5 ratio. Interview. Interview by selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary and contractual basis. Appointment for 11 months. No claim for regular employment or permanency.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Parbhani.
